headline: Last session: Sensex soared nearly 700 points as Nifty surpassed 25,700 driven by strong FII inflows.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.

why: Record FII buying helped extend the four-week market rally during the last session.
Concerns over Fed rate hikes and a global AI selloff previously exerted downward pressure on equities.
Tata Steel announced a major deal to sell two of its business units to APL Apollo Tubes for ₹28,000 crore.
Punjab National Bank clarified that its ₹5,000 crore ECL provision requirement will not hit profitability.
whatHappening: The Indian stock market is closed today due to the weekend.
In the last trading session, equity benchmarks Sensex and Nifty climbed to 9-month highs.
APL Apollo Tubes agreed to buy Tata Steel's tubes and colors business for ₹28,000 crore.
Shree Cement set a target to cross 100 MT capacity in 3-4 years with expected growth of 9-10%.
summary: The Indian stock market is closed today for the weekend. On the last trading session, Sensex and Nifty touched 9-month highs following robust foreign institutional buying. Meanwhile, major deal announcements included APL Apollo acquiring Tata Steel's tubes and colors business for ₹28,000 crore.
